bull_case: Rubin의 전력당 처리량·토큰비용 개선과 주요 hyperscaler·AI cloud·OEM의 주문은 제품이 고객의 AI factory TCO와 수익성을 직접 개선한다는 강한 신호다. 네트워킹·CPU까지 wallet share가 확대되고 있다.
bear_case: 직접 고객의 AR 집중이 높고 DSO가 60일로 늘었으며 NVIDIA가 일부 AI cloud의 토지·전력·용량 확보를 지원한다. 고객 ROI가 약해질 경우 금융지원이 수요 품질을 가릴 수 있다.
thesis: 고객가치는 강하지만 유지율/NRR 같은 전통적 SaaS 지표는 공개되지 않는다. Rubin의 TCO 개선 주장, 광범위한 주문, Data Center $89B 매출은 지불의사를 지지한다. 반면 AR 집중과 연장 결제조건, AI cloud 지원 약정은 고객 수요의 질을 계속 검증해야 하는 이유다.

evidence.claim: NVIDIA says Vera Rubin delivers 30x higher throughput per megawatt and 35x lower token cost versus Grace Blackwell Ultra, directly targeting customer TCO.
Production shipments of Vera Rubin had begun and NVIDIA reported purchase orders from every major hyperscaler, AI cloud and system OEM.
Five direct customers represented 22%, 14%, 13%, 11% and 10% of accounts receivable as of July 26, 2026.
CFO commentary reported DSO of 60 days versus 45 sequentially because of extended payment terms on large multi-quarter agreements.
NVIDIA disclosed arrangements that assist select customers with land, power and data-center capacity and a revenue-share model with certain AI clouds.

counterevidence: No public NRR/GRR/churn series exists for core data-center customers.
Extended payment terms and infrastructure support can blur pure end-customer demand quality.
AR is concentrated among a small number of large direct customers.
Vendor-published TCO benchmarks may not generalize to every production workload.
unknowns: Customer-level realized ROI after power and financing costs
Repeat-order cadence for Rubin after initial deployment
Share of revenue tied to extended payment terms or supported AI-cloud arrangements

uncertainties.rationale: TCO evidence is strong but largely vendor-reported.
Public retention/churn metrics are unavailable; repeat orders are inferred from platform adoption.
Customer financing/support makes some demand quality harder to isolate.

falsifiers: Rubin repeat orders weaken materially after initial deployments.
DSO and customer support commitments rise faster than revenue for multiple quarters.
Independent workloads fail to show meaningful TCO advantage versus custom silicon/competitors.

hard_veto_flags.rationale: Current revenue scale, repeat platform adoption and system-level TCO evidence show genuine customer value; support arrangements are a risk but do not currently appear to be the primary growth engine.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 단일 제품·단일 고객·단일 규제에 대한 치명적 종속성
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Data Center dominates revenue and AR is concentrated, but demand spans multiple hyperscalers/AI clouds/OEMs and the platform includes GPU, CPU, networking and software; China restrictions are material but not currently fatal.

key_kpis.name: DSO
key_kpis.threshold: Avoid persistent expansion beyond current 60-day level

key_kpis.name: Rubin repeat orders
key_kpis.threshold: Broad repeat orders beyond launch cohort

key_kpis.name: Customer concentration
key_kpis.threshold: No single customer becomes dominant in receivables/revenue

subscores.rationale: System-level TCO improvement and broad orders indicate strong willingness to pay.
Adoption is broad but direct retention/usage cohort data are not disclosed.
Massive scale and platform expansion indicate favorable economics, with financing-support caveats.
